The enhancement related to CSI-RS overhead reduction in Rel-20 is rather straightforward. As per the WID, CSI-RS density values of 1/3 and 1/6 are limited to the case with 48 ports while the CSI-RS density values of 1/4 and 1/8 are applicable for the 64 port and 128 port cases. A 48 port CSI-RS configuration is achieved by aggregating either two 24 port CSI-RS resources or aggregating three 16 port CSI-RS resources. Hence, the densities of 1/3 and 1/6 need to be added to rows 11-15 of Table 7.4.1.5.3-1 in 3GPP TS 38.211. A 64 port CSI-RS configuration is achieved by aggregating either two 32 port CSI-RS resources or aggregating four 16 port CSI-RS resources.
